moves.quote:
Your client is not interested. Now what? 👀

My first real estate clients did not want to talk to me either.
And very quickly, I realised something.

citations.quote: I started in Dubai real estate in 2015, right at the beginning of the previous buyer’s market, when prices had already started moving down.
Knowing the market and knowing the projects was not enough.

summary.text: The author shares experiences from their early days in the Dubai real estate market when cold calling and referrals were primary lead generation methods. Due to a lack of referrals, the author had to rely on cold calling, which involved reaching out to uninterested potential clients and learning sales through these challenging interactions.

episodes.title: Reflecting on Initial Real Estate Challenges

moves.quote: How to create enough interest for the next step?

moves.action: Highlighting the need for a structured pre-call strategy
moves.quote: If every new client still feels like a new experiment, despite all the scripts, follow-ups and sales techniques you have tried, the problem may not be what you write after the call.

citations.quote: How to create enough interest for the next step?
That is a skill. And it can be learned.

summary.text: Engaging uninterested clients requires specific skills that can be learned. The author stresses the importance of maintaining client interest beyond initial contact and shares insights on developing these skills along with teaching them to others.
